items.headline: IDFC FIRST Bank ne nayi callable FD rates lagu ki hain
items.what: IDFC FIRST Bank ke callable fixed deposit rates ab update ho gaye hain, ₹3 crore se kam rakam par lagu hain. Isme payout, jaldi todne par paisa lene ka option, Income-tax Act ke hisaab se TDS aur DICGC coverage ka bhi zikar hai.
items.who: Individual ya business jo IDFC FIRST Bank me callable fixed deposits karte hain, ₹3 crore se kam amount ke liye.
items.action: Agar aap IDFC FIRST Bank me FD rakh rahe hain ya plan kar rahe hain, to naye rates aur premature closure ki terms check karen. Apne tax advisor ya bank se details confirm karen.

items.headline: Public shareholding ke naye minimum rules aaye
items.what: 2026 ke liye minimum public offer ki requirements revise hui hain. IPO ke threshold, 25% minimum public shareholding ki time limit aur kuch specific reliefs jaise IFSC companies ke liye changes samjhaaye gaye hain.
items.who: Listed companies ya IPO plan kar rahe promoters aur compliance professionals.
items.action: Jo bhi company IPO ya listing plan kar rahi hai, naye MPS aur IPO ke limit waale rules ko detail mein samjhe. Company secretary ya compliance advisor se discuss karein.

items.headline: PNB ne outward remittance ki service details share ki
items.what: Punjab National Bank ne apni resident outward remittance service ki details di hai. Isme KYC, limit, exchange rate cost, GST, TCS aur settlement process shamil hai.
items.who: Individuals ya businesses jo PNB se foreign outward remittance bhejna chahte hain.
items.action: PNB se remittance plan kar rahe hain to KYC, charges aur TCS ki poori jaankari PNB branch ya relationship manager se lein. Saare documents ready rakhein.

items.headline: YES Bank ke callable FD rates 2 June 2026 se lagu
items.what: YES Bank ne resident callable fixed deposits ke naye rates announce kiye hain, jo ₹3 crore se kam deposits par lagu hain. Premature closure ki suvidha, TDS aur DICGC cover bhi hai.
items.who: Individuals ya businesses jo YES Bank me callable FD rakhna chahte hain, ₹3 crore se kam amount ke liye.
items.action: YES Bank FD lene se pehle naye rates aur premature closure ki rules bank se check karein. Tax implication ke liye advisor se discuss karein.

items.headline: IDFC FIRST Bank ne callable FD ki naye rates launch kiye
items.what: IDFC FIRST Bank ne resident callable fixed deposit ke liye naye interest rates announce kiye hain. FD ki maximum limit ₹3 crore ke neeche hai. Payout, premature closure, TDS (Income-tax Act 2025) aur DICGC cover bhi available hai.
items.who: Jo log IDFC FIRST Bank mein callable FD kholna chahte hain, khaas kar ₹3 crore ke neeche deposit walon ke liye.
items.action: Aap agar naya FD kholne ka soch rahe hain, to latest rate sheet check karein. Premature closure aur TDS rules bhi samajh lein. Bank se details lein.

items.headline: SEBI ne Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) mein badlav kiye
items.what: 2026 ke liye revised rules aaye hain. Ab IPO karne wali companies ke liye nayi public offer limits aur minimum public shareholding (MPS) ke timeframes set kiye gaye hain. Kuch companies ko IFSC mein exemption bhi milegi. SVR shares ke liye bhi nayi guidelines hain.
items.who: IPO lane wali companies aur listed companies ko especially dhyan dena hai.
items.action: Jo companies IPO plan kar rahi hain, unhe nayi MPS requirements check karni chahiye. Compliance ke liye apne compliance officer/CS se consult karein.

items.headline: YES Bank ne resident callable FD ki naye rates lagu kiye
items.what: YES Bank ne callable fixed deposit mein naye interest rates effective kiye hain for deposits below ₹3 crore. Payout, premature closure options, TDS aur DICGC controls bhi cover kiye gaye hain.
items.who: YES Bank ke deposit holders jo callable FD le rahe hain, khaaskar ₹3 crore se kam wale.
items.action: Agar FD renew ya naya kholna hai, to naye rates dekh lein. Premature closure aur tax implication ko samajh lein. Details bank se confirm karein.

items.headline: PNB ne outward remittance ki service details share ki
items.what: Punjab National Bank ne apni resident outward-remittance (LRS) service ki puri process, KYC, charges, GST, TCS, aur grievance mechanism cover kiya hai. Isme exchange rate, transaction limits aur settlement ka process samjhaya gaya hai.
items.who: Individuals ya businesses jo PNB se bahar paisa bhejna chahte hain LRS ke through.
items.action: Remittance bhejne se pehle, PNB branch se KYC, charges aur limit details lein. GST aur TCS ki implications bhi check karein.

items.headline: Sitaram Denims ne apna IPO ka DRHP file kiya
items.what: Sitaram Denims India Limited ne 3 November 2026 ko apna DRHP file kiya hai. Isme company ke fund use, financials aur IPO offer ki structure ka details diya gaya hai.
items.who: Investors jo upcoming Sitaram Denims ke IPO mein interested hain.
items.action: Agar IPO mein invest ka plan hai, to DRHP ka details study kar lein. Company ke financials aur risk factors dhyan se padhein.

items.headline: PNB foreign outward remittance ki services detail mein aayi.
items.what: Punjab National Bank ne resident outward-remittance service ki details di hai. Isme purpose, KYC ki zaroorat, limit, exchange rate ka cost, settlement process, GST aur TCS ka zikr hai.
items.who: Woh individual ya business jo PNB se foreign outward remittance bhejna chahte hain.
items.action: Agar aapko foreign remittance bhejna hai to PNB ki KYC requirements, charges, GST aur TCS check karein. Apne remittance purpose aur limit samajh lein.

items.headline: RBI ne draft Priority Sector Lending Directions par comment maange.
items.what: RBI ne paanch alag-alag bank categories ke liye draft Priority Sector Lending Directions jari kiye hain. Ispar comments 26 November 2026 tak mangi gayi hain. Matlab, har bank ko kuch khas sector (kisan, MSME, etc.) ko loan dena compulsory hota hai, uski guideline hai.
items.who: Saare banks aur stakeholders jinke liye priority sector lending applicable hai.
items.action: Agar aap banking ya finance sector se hain to draft directions padhkar RBI ko apni suggestion ya comment bhej sakte hain.

items.headline: Non-bank Payment System Operators ke liye cyber security rules consolidate hue.
items.what: RBI ne saare purane digital payment security rules ko consolidate karke ek Master Directions jari kiye hain. Yeh non-bank payment system operators ke liye cyber security aur payment safety pe focus karta hai.
items.who: Non-bank Payment System Operators, jaise wallet providers aur payment gateway companies.
items.action: Aap agar PSO ya fintech operate karte hain to RBI ki nayi Master Directions ko padhkar compliance process ko update karein.

items.headline: Public shareholding wale rules 2026 ke liye revise hue.
items.what: Minimum public offer, IPO threshold aur 25% public shareholding ki timelines 2026 mein revise ki gayi hain. Kuch exemptions bhi hain, jaise IFSC ke cases mein.
items.who: India ki listed companies, IPO lane wale promoters aur IFSC mein operate karne wale businesses.
items.action: Agar aap listed company mein stakeholder hain ya IPO ki planning kar rahe hain to nayi MPS requirements check karein. Compliance timeline check zaroor karein.

items.headline: PNB foreign outward remittance: KYC, charges, TCS guide
items.what: Punjab National Bank ke outward remittance service mein KYC, limit, exchange rate cost, GST, TCS aur complain process cover hua hai. Saara detail review hua hai ki LRS ke under paisa bahar bhejne par kya-kya dhyaan dena hai.
items.who: India ke resident individuals jo PNB se foreign remittance bhejna chahte hain, khas taur par LRS ke under.
items.action: Agar PNB ke through paise bahar bhejne ka plan hai to apna KYC status, limit aur charges detail check karo. TCS aur complaint process bhi samjho.

items.headline: YES Bank callable FD: New rates effective from 2 June 2026
items.what: YES Bank ne resident callable fixed deposit rates update kiye hain, jo 2 June 2026 se lagu hain. Ismein premature closure, TDS aur DICGC safety cover details bhi included hain.
items.who: Individual depositors jinka FD amount ₹3 crore se kam hai YES Bank mein.
items.action: Agar YES Bank mein naya FD khol rahe ho ya renew kar rahe ho, to new rates aur premature closure rules dekh lo. Tax aur insurance coverage bhi verify karo.

items.headline: Hunger Pangs Limited ne DRHP file kiya, IPO taiyari start
items.what: Hunger Pangs Limited ne apna Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) 21 October 2026 ko file kiya hai. Ismein company ka financial check aur risk disclosure hua hai, lekin IPO ke terms abhi final nahi hain.
items.who: Wo investisseurs ya businesses jo Hunger Pangs Limited IPO mein interest rakhte hain.
items.action: Agar IPO mein invest karne ka plan hai, to DRHP ache se padh kar financials aur risks samjho. Issue terms aane ka intezaar karo, filhaal koi decision na lo.

items.headline: RBL Bank callable FD: 1 October 2026 se naye rates lagu
items.what: RBL Bank ne callable FD 18 se 60 mahine tak ke liye naye rates announce kiye hain. Alag age group ke liye alag rates hain. Saath mein premature closure aur DICGC coverage details di gayi hain.
items.who: RBL Bank ke depositors jo 18 mahine se 60 mahine ki callable FD rakhte hain ya open karna chahte hain.
items.action: Agar RBL Bank mein FD lena hai ya renew karna hai to naye rates aur closure terms dekh lo. Senior citizens apna rate cross-check karein.

items.headline: SEBI accredited investor rules: manager verification, 3 saal validity
items.what: SEBI ne naye accredited investor rules notify kiye hain jisme verification ab manager-led ho sakti hai. Accreditation 3 saal tak valid rahegi. Eligibility aur record keeping rules update huye hain.
items.who: Jo log ya entities accredited investor status pane ya renew karna chahte hain, fund managers aur wealth managers.
items.action: Eligible investors ko apne manager se verification process puchhna chahiye. Naye documents aur validity samjho, records properly rakhna.

items.headline: RBI Master Directions: PSOs ke liye cyber aur payment security
items.what: RBI ne non-bank Payment System Operators ke liye cyber resilience aur digital payment security ki Master Directions notify ki hain. Saare existing aur naye security rules ko consolidate kiya gaya hai.
items.who: Non-bank payment system operators jinhe RBI ne authorize kiya hai, jaise fintech, payment gateways, wallets.
items.action: PSO apni IT aur payment security policy Master Directions ke according update karein. Management ko naye compliance points par kaam karna hai.

items.headline: Sharekhan currency derivatives: Registration, charges, eligibility guide
items.what: Sharekhan ka currency derivatives service ka profile diya gaya hai. Registration, eligibility, KYC, charges aur settlement ke process cover hain. Resident users ke liye guide bhi di hai.
items.who: Individuals ya businesses jo Sharekhan par currency derivatives trade karna chahte hain.
items.action: Agar trading ka plan hai to registration aur KYC process check karo. Charges aur settlement rules bhi samjho.

items.headline: South Eastern Coalfields IPO DRHP mein OFS, business details
items.what: South Eastern Coalfields Limited ne apna DRHP file kiya hai jisme 668.06 million-shares ka Offer For Sale (OFS) hoga. Analysis mein Coal India ki ownership aur company ke mining operations ki details di gayi hain.
items.who: IPO mein interested investors aur jo mining sector companies dekh rahe hain.
items.action: Agar aap IPO mein invest karne ka soch rahe hain toh DRHP padh kar company ke business aur risk samjhein.

items.headline: SEBI Mutual Fund Schemes mein Net Fund Settlement allow karega April 2027 se
items.what: SEBI ne mutual fund cash market trades ke funds ka scheme-level net settlement allow kar diya hai. Securities ki settlement abhi bhi gross hi hogi.
items.who: Mutual fund houses aur unke fund managers.
items.action: April 2027 se statement aur settlement process mein badlaav expect karein. Process samajhne ke liye scheme ke RTA/Fund House se detail lein.

items.headline: SEBI Accredited Investor Framework 2026: Manager-led verification aur record rules
items.what: SEBI ke naye accredited-investor framework mein manager-led verification allow hai, teen saal ki validity hogi aur eligibility aur records ki requirements revise ki gayi hain.
items.who: Portfolio managers, wealth managers, aur accredited investor banne wale high net worth individuals.
items.action: Agar aap accredited investor banna chahte hain toh latest eligibility proof aur manager-led process ki details prepare karein.

items.headline: IFSC Banking Units – Licensing, capital aur internet banking rules FAQs
items.what: IFSCA FAQs mein IFSC Banking Unit banane ke licence, USD 20 million capital ki shart, liquidity aur KYC norms aur internet banking ke basic rules bataye gaye hain.
items.who: Jo IFSC mein banking unit kholne ka plan bana rahe hain – special banking zones mein business wale.
items.action: Capital, compliance aur licensing process ke FAQs IFSCA ki site se padhein. Saare documents aur capital ready rakhein.

items.headline: Cyber Resilience aur Payment Security: Non-bank Payment System Operators ke liye nayi guidelines
items.what: RBI ne non-bank payment system operators ke liye cyber resilience aur digital payment security controls par Master Directions release ki hain.
items.who: Saare non-bank payment gateways, wallets aur payment system operators.
items.action: Guidelines detail mein padhein aur IT/cyber security systems nayi requirements ke hisaab se update karwaen.

items.headline: Non-bank payment operators: New cyber and payment security rules
items.what: RBI ne non-bank payment system operators ke liye cyber security aur digital payment ki safety ke naye rules issue kiye hain. Master directions mein compliance ka scope aur control systems clear kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Har non-bank payment system operator, jaise wallet, payment gateway, ya fintech firms, jinke upar RBI ka regulation hai.
items.action: Agar aap kisi non-bank payment operator ke compliance ya IT team mein ho, to Master Directions padho aur cyber security framework update karo. Regulated entity ho to turant apne controls review karo.

items.headline: Mutual Funds: April 2027 se net fund settlement allowed
items.what: SEBI ne allow kiya hai ki mutual fund schemes apne cash market transactions mein net fund settlement use kar sakengi, securities settlement ab bhi gross basis par hoga. Yani paisa ek hi baar net basis pe transfer hoga aur securities alag-alag kategi.
items.who: Sabhi mutual fund houses aur unke scheme administrators jinmein cash market trades hoti hain.
items.action: Mutual fund operation/finance team apne process ko April 2027 ke net settlement framework ke hisaab se align karein. Investors ko settlement reports check karni chahiye.

items.headline: NRI, OCI, foreign investors: SEBI ka digital KYC 3 Dec 2026 se
items.what: SEBI ne remote digital KYC ki facility start ki hai un sab logon ke liye jo India ke bahar rehte hain, jaise NRI, OCI aur foreign nationals. Ab poora KYC process digitally ho sakta hai, documents and verification video call se possible hai.
items.who: Sab NRI, OCI, ya foreign national investors jo SEBI-registered intermediary ke through invest kar rahe hain.
items.action: Agar aap ya aapka client abroad hai, to December 2026 se KYC ke liye physical documents aur visit ki zaroorat nahi. Digital KYC process, document list aur verification steps apne intermediary se check karo.

items.headline: SEBI ne Accredited Investor rules ka framework update kiya
items.what: SEBI ne AIF Master Circular mein accredited investor reforms, GARUDA framework aur winding-up guidelines add kiye hain. Accredited investor ka process aur conditions mein changes kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), existing ya chahne wale accredited investors aur fund managers.
items.action: AIF managers apna client onboarding aur compliance accredited investor ke naye framework ke hisaab se update karein. Qualification aur application details check karein.

items.headline: SEBI working group to review Innovators Growth Platform
items.what: SEBI ne ek working group banaya hai jo Innovators Growth Platform (IGP) ke rules jaise listing, capital raise, aur investor eligibility ko review karega. Yeh startups ki regulatory requirements ko asaan banane par focus hai.
items.who: Jo bhi innovation-led startups IGP par list hona chahte hain ya capital raise karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap startup founder hain ya IGP listing advisor hain, toh naye rules ke liye SEBI ki updates par nazar rakhein.

items.headline: Digital KYC ab NRIs, OCIs, foreign nationals ke liye allowed
items.what: SEBI ne digital KYC process ko NRIs, OCIs aur un foreign nationals ke liye allow kiya hai jo FATF-compliant countries mein hain. Naye verification rules lagu honge 3 December 2026 se.
items.who: Jo NRIs, OCIs, aur foreign nationals India me investment account kholna chahte hain, aur financial intermediaries jo inki onboarding karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap NRI ya OCI hain toh December ke baad digital KYC ke liye apne service provider se sampark karein. Intermediaries ko naye rules ki compliance check karni hai.

items.headline: NPS scheme naming aur display rules badle
items.what: PFRDA ne NPS scheme ke naam, risk-category disclosure aur Point of Presence (PoP) platform display ke rules update kiye hain. Circular 52/2026 ke hisaab se yeh changes 1 December 2026 se lagu honge.
items.who: All NPS scheme providers aur PoP platforms jin par NPS products listed hain.
items.action: NPS providers ko apne product names aur risk category display ko update karna hai. PoP platforms ko naye format mein details dikhani hongi. Compliance deadline ko miss na karein.

items.headline: IRDAI ne insurer registration aur share transfer rules diye
items.what: IRDAI ne insurers ke registration, capital structure, share transfers aur amalgamation ke new rules ek master circular me jari kiye hain. Yeh 2 November 2026 se effective hain.
items.who: Insurance companies jo naya registration, capital restructuring ya share transfer ki planning kar rahi hain.
items.action: Aap insurance company operate karte hain to nayi guideline Master Circular 2026 dhang se padhkar apni compliance team ko update karein.

items.headline: REITs aur InvITs unit par Depository Receipts ka naya framework
items.what: SEBI ne REITs (Real Estate Investment Trusts) aur InvITs (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) ki units par Depository Receipts issue karne ka naya framework laya hai. Isse international investors ko participation ka mauka milega.
items.who: REITs, InvITs aur unke investors jo international market se funds raise karna chahte hain.
items.action: REITs/InvITs ki management ko SEBI ka latest circular check karna chahiye agar woh apni units ke against DRs issue plan kar rahe hain.

items.headline: NPS scheme ke naam aur display rules badle
items.what: PFRDA ne NPS scheme ke naam, risk-category dikhane ka tareeka, aur PoP platform par display rule badla hai. Sabhi ko 1 December 2026 tak naye rules follow karne hain.
items.who: NPS distributors, Points of Presence (PoPs), aur NPS sewa dikhane wale platforms par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap NPS distributor ya platform run karte ho to apne display, scheme naming aur risk-category disclosure ki compliance PFRDA ke naye circular ke hisaab se kar lo.

items.headline: BIS registration process, product list aur renewal guide
items.what: BIS registration ke liye naye process, documentation, aur schemes (ISI, CRS, FMCS, etc.) ki jaankari di gayi hai. Fees, renewal aur testing ki poori process samjhai gayi hai.

items.action: Agar aapka product BIS ke scope mein aata hai to naya process padh lo, required documents jama karo aur testing/renewal ki taiyyari kar lo.

items.headline: IRDAI ka naya Master Circular insurance registration par
items.what: IRDAI ne insurance company registration, capital structure, share transfer aur amalgamation ke rules ek naye Master Circular mein update kiye hain. 2 November 2026 se lagu hain.
items.who: Sabhi existing aur naye insurance companies pa lagu hai jo IRDAI ke under registered hain ya registration chahte hain.
items.action: Insurance company ya to nayi ho ya purani, ab registration, capital ya share transfer plan bana rahe ho to latest IRDAI Master Circular check karo.

items.headline: REIT units par depository receipts ka SEBI ka naya framework
items.what: SEBI ne REIT (Real Estate Investment Trusts) units ke depository receipts issue karne ke liye eligibility, IFSC listing, pricing, voting aur compliance rules diye hain.
items.who: REITs, IFSC mein listed entities, aur jo depository receipts issue karwana chahte hain un par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap REIT ya investor ho, toh naye depository receipts aur compliance ka framework padhkar hi plan banaao.

items.headline: InvIT units par depository receipts issue ke naye rules
items.what: SEBI ne InvIT (Infrastructure Investment Trusts) units ke depository receipts ki eligibility, IFSC listing aur compliance guidelines issue ki hain.
items.who: InvITs aur jo IFSC mein depository receipts issue karna chahte hain un par lagu hai.
items.action: InvIT aur investors dono apni issue planning aur compliance SEBI ke naye guidelines ke hisaab se update karein.

items.headline: REIT units par Depository Receipts ka naya framework
items.what: SEBI ne ek naya framework jari kiya hai jisse ab REITs units par depository receipts issue kiye ja sakte hain. Isse investors ko naye tareeke milenge REITs mein investment karne ke.
items.who: REITs mein invest karne wale domestic aur foreign investors aur REIT sponsor companies ke liye kaam ki cheez hai.
items.action: Agar aap REITs ya depository receipts mein interested hain to apne advisor ko nayi guidelines samjhne ke liye consult karein.

items.headline: InvITs units par Depository Receipts ka naya ruleset
items.what: SEBI ne InvITs units par depository receipts issue karne ka framework jari kiya hai. Ye rules InvIT investments ko simplify karte hain aur global investors ko bhi mauka dete hain.
items.who: InvITs mein invest karne wale domestic aur international investors aur InvIT sponsor entities.
items.action: InvITs promoters ya advisors apne compliance aur issuance process ko update karein nayi guideline ke hisaab se.

items.headline: DCB Bank ka 60–61 month FD offer aur slab details update hue
items.what: DCB Bank ne 60–61 month callable fixed deposit scheme ki rates, senior citizens slab, premature closure policy, aur DICGC cover ki terms update ki hain.

items.action: Agar aap DCB Bank me naya ya renew FD soch rahe hain to nayi terms aur rate slab ko bank se check karein.

items.headline: Karnataka Bank ne 555-day fixed deposit naya offer diya
items.what: Karnataka Bank ne 555 din ke special callable FD ki terms launch ki hai. Ismein premature closure, TDS, aur DICGC cover ki info hai.
items.who: Karnataka Bank customers jo short to medium term FD plan kar rahe hain.
items.action: Log apni FD opening se pehle nayi terms aur TDS impact bank se samajh lein, khaaskar agar premature withdrawal plan hai.

items.headline: FPIs ke KYC review ki periodicity ab bilkul simple
items.what: SEBI ne FPIs ke liye KYC periodicity process simplify kiya hai. Isse compliance ka load kam hoga.
items.who: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) aur unke compliance team ke liye zaroori update hai.
items.action: FPI compliance team nayi reporting periodicity policies ko apne system me update karein.

items.headline: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) ki time se pehle redemption value announce
items.what: SGB 2021-22 Series VII holders ke liye, 5 saal ke baad time se pehle redemption ka option hai. RBI ne bata diya hai ki 2 November 2026 ko redeem karne par per unit ₹14,167 milenge. Value gold ke 3 din ke average price par based hai.

items.action: Agar early redemption ka plan hai, apne demat ya bank ke SGB service provider se 2 November 2026 se pehle process ke liye contact karo.

items.headline: BLS Polymers ne IPO ka final prospectus file kiya
items.what: BLS Polymers ka IPO close hone ke baad company ne final prospectus file kiya hai. Prospectus me issue price, total fresh issue, financials aur allotment related details milengi.
items.who: IPO investors, financial advisors aur BLS Polymers ke potential shareholders.
items.action: IPO details, price aur allotment process check karni ho to final prospectus ka review karo. File public domain me hai.

items.what: Ek guide aayi hai jo batata hai ki IPO ke baad listed company ko NSE/BSE filings, SEBI LODR, PIT disclosures, quarterly reporting, PAN freeze jaisi cheezein monitor karni padti hain.
items.who: Nayi listed companies aur unke compliance teams.

items.headline: IPO se pehle bhi kai compliance steps follow karne padte hain

items.headline: Debenture Trustees ke liye SEBI ne compliance ka time badhaya

items.action: Agar aap Debenture Trustee ho to, compliance ki revised deadline ki detail SEBI circular me dekho aur terms jaldi complete karo.

items.action: Agar aap is bond ke eligible holder hain to maturity pe redemption ke liye documents ready rakhein aur apne bank/demat operator ko time pe instructions bhejein.

items.what: Jaise hi company stock market me list hoti hai, usko regular disclosures, NSE/BSE filings, SEBI LODR, PIT disclosures, quarterly financials aur PAN freezing rules follow karne padte hain.

items.action: IPO ke baad sabhi compliance process ka schedule bana lein, filings ki list banayein aur deadlines par dhyan de. SEBI ki LODR aur PIT circulars padhein.

items.headline: IPO se pehle company ko kuch zaroori compliance ready karne honge
items.what: IPO karne wali company ko DRHP, SEBI LODR, PIT, SDD, board approvals, related party deals aur listing ki requirements pooray karne hote hain.

items.action: IPO ki tayari me sabhi documentation, internal records aur related party disclosures pehle se ready kar lein.

items.headline: Debenture Trustees ko SEBI ke bahar wali activities ke liye extra time milega
items.what: Debenture Trustees (DTs) ko SEBI ke purview ke bahar activities ke liye compliance terms poore karne ke liye ab aur time mil gaya hai. SEBI ne timeline extend kar diya hai.

items.action: DTs apne compliance deadlines dobara check karein aur revised extension period ka pata karein. Zaroorat ho to apne compliance team se consult karein.
