items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: Zerodha NSE Currency Derivatives: SEBI registration details
items.what: Zerodha ki NSE currency derivatives service ka profile hai, jo SEBI registered hai. Isme eligible INR currency pairs, declaration, charges, settlement aur risks diye gaye hain.
items.who: Currency trading karne wale individuals aur entities jo Zerodha platform use karte hain, unke liye hai.
items.action: Currency derivatives mein trade karne se pehle SEBI registration check karo, saare eligible pairs aur charges samajh lo, aur KYC complete karo.

items.headline: ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund ki nayi scheme details aayi
items.what: ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund ke official scheme features, mandate, exit load, plan aur NIFTY 100 TRI ke linkage ki jaankari mili hai. Isme risk aur tax impact bhi bataya gaya hai.
items.who: Jo investors apna paisa large cap mutual fund schemes me daalna soch rahe hain ya ICICI Prudential ke client hain, unke liye hai.
items.action: Fund ka mandate, costs, exit load aur risk profile achhi tarah samajh lo. Investment se pehle offer document padh lo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: SEBI Listing Regulations 2026 mein amendment lagu
items.what: SEBI ne apne Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2026 mein amendment kiya hai. Isme listed companies ke compliance aur disclosure rules mein badlav hua hai.
items.who: Listed companies ya jo listing ki planning kar rahe hain, unke directors, compliance officers aur CS ke liye hai.
items.action: Nayi amendment copy carefully padho. Disclosure aur compliance ki updated checklist bana lo. Q&A ke liye SEBI site check karo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: SEBI ne listing aur disclosure rules ko amend kiya
items.what: SEBI ne Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations mein third amendment kiya hai. Is amendment se listed companies ko apni compliance responsibilities mein kuch changes aa sakte hain.
items.who: Yeh sabhi listed companies aur jo listing ki planning kar rahe hain un par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap listed company ho ya listing ki soch rahe ho, toh naye regulations ko padho. Compliance team ya company secretary se baat karo. SEBI site par regulation padho: links yahan neeche hai.

items.headline: RBI ne UAPA sanction list ko update kiya hai
items.what: RBI ne Section 51A UAPA, 1967 ke tehat UNSC ki sanctions list mein 3 entries ka amendment notify kiya hai. Ye compliance se judi update hai.
items.who: Commercial banks, Small Finance Banks, Payment Banks, Urban aur Rural Co-operative Banks, RRBs, Local Area Banks, NBFCs, Asset Reconstruction Companies aur All India Financial Institutions par lagu hai.
items.action: IT aur compliance teams ko naye sanction list aur UNSC list ke amendments ko check karna chahiye. Apne KYC aur AML screening process update kar lo.

items.headline: ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund ka current scheme mandate
items.what: ICICI Prudential Large Cap Fund ka mandate large cap stocks mein invest karna hai. Ab iska naam aur official scheme ka structure badla gaya hai.
items.who: Mutual fund investors jo ICICI Prudential ke is fund mein invest karte hain, un par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap investor ho toh apne fund ka mandate, exit load aur tax implication check karo. Scheme ke naye documents padh lo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: IPO mein fresh issue aur offer for sale ka farq
items.what: IPO mein fresh issue ka matlab company naye shares bechti hai aur paisa company ko milta hai. Offer for sale mein purane shareholders apne shares bechte hain.
items.who: Jo bhi IPO mein invest karne ka plan bana rahe hain, un par lagu hai.
items.action: IPO prospectus padho aur samjho ki issue fresh hai ya offer for sale hai. Investment decision lene se pehle structure samajh lo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: Mutual fund direct aur regular plan mein kharcha ka asar
items.what: Direct plan aur regular plan dono mein same scheme hoti hai, par expense ratio alag hota hai. Expense ratio ka chhota farq lambi avadhi mein bada ho sakta hai.
items.who: Sab mutual fund investors jo direct ya distributor ke through invest karte hain.
items.action: Investment karte waqt direct aur regular plan ke expense aur returns compare karo. Apni investment strategy accordingly set karo.

items.headline: Banks ko UNSC sanctions list update follow karna hoga
items.what: RBI ne banking companies ko bola hai ki wo UAPA Act ke section 51A ke tahat, United Nations sanctions list mein latest changes ko immediately apne processes mein apply karein. 3 entries sanctions list mein update hui hain.
items.who: Commercial banks, small finance banks, payment banks, co-operative banks, NBFCs aur financial institutions sab par lagu hai.
items.action: Compliance team apni sanctions screening list update karein. Client onboarding aur due diligence mein naya list use karein.

items.headline: InvIT me depository receipts aur voting rule update
items.what: SEBI ne Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) ke rules badle hain. Ab depository receipts allow hain aur voting ke requirements revise hue hain. Sponsor exit par dissenting holders ki raksha ke provisions hain.
items.who: InvITs banane wali companies aur unke investors par lagu hai.
items.action: Legal/Compliance team ko InvIT structure aur voting policies review karni chahiye. Sponsor exit ke case mein naye dissent protections samjhein.

items.headline: SEBI listing regulations 2026 me naye rules lagu
items.what: SEBI ne Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026 notify kiye hain. Isme listed companies ke liye fresh compliance rules aaye hain.
items.who: Share market me listed companies aur unke compliance officer par lagu hai.
items.action: Compliance team ko amendment document dhyan se padhna aur naye compliance steps tayar karna hai.

items.headline: InvIT mein naye depository receipts aur voting rules aaye
items.what: SEBI ne InvIT rules badle hain. Ab depository receipts allowed hain aur voting requirement 75% kar di gayi hai. Alag hone wale sponsor par dissenting unitholders ko protection di hai.
items.who: InvITs, unitholders aur sponsors jo exit plan kar rahe hain.
items.action: InvIT structure ya investment mein ho to nayi receipt aur voting policy check karo. Sponsor exit ho toh dissenting unitholders ki protection samjho.

items.headline: BOB Earth Green Term Deposit: naya deposit option
items.what: Bank of Baroda ne Earth Green Term Deposit scheme shuru ki hai. Isme callable aur non-callable terms, premature closure aur deposit insurance available hai.
items.who: Bank of Baroda ke account holders ya naye depositors.
items.action: Nayi deposit lene se pehle scheme ke terms samjho, Form 121 complete karo aur insurance cover ki details check karo.

items.headline: SGB 2020-21 Series VII ka premature redemption rate announced
items.what: Sovereign Gold Bond 2020-21 Series VII ki premature redemption aaj se possible hai. Redemption price ₹14,614 per unit fix kiya gaya hai.
items.who: Jin logon ke paas SGB 2020-21 Series VII hai.
items.action: Agar redeem karna hai toh apne banker ya DP se request daalo. IBJA ke gold price basis par amount milega.

items.headline: Investment Adviser banne ke rules: eligibility, fees, compliance
items.what: SEBI ne Investment Adviser banne ke liye guide jari ki hai jisme eligibility, NISM certification, deposit, fees aur compliance details di gayi hai.
items.who: Jo bhi Investment Adviser banna chahte hain.
items.action: Form bharne se pehle eligibility, certification aur documents ki list check karo. Compliance requirements ko samjho yahi se start karo.

items.headline: Non-convertible debt securities ke liye listing ab mandatory
items.what: SEBI ke Third Amendment 2026 ke hisaab se ab listed entities ko subsequent non-convertible debt securities ko list karna padega.
items.who: Specified listed companies jo debt securities nikaal rahi hain.
items.action: Agar debt securities issue kar rahe ho to nayi listing requirement follow karo. SEBI regulation 62A dekho.

items.headline: HDFC Bank 18-month FD October 2026 rate, tax aur insurance
items.what: HDFC Bank ne sub-₹3 crore 18-month Fixed Deposit ke liye naye rate bataye hain. Isme tax (TDS) aur DICGC insurance cover ki details bhi hai.
items.who: HDFC mein FD kholne ya renew karne wale customers.
items.action: FD ka interest rate, withdrawal rule aur insurance cover dhyan se check karo. TDS ka impact bhi dekh lo.

items.headline: SGB 2020-21 Series VII ka premature redemption 19 October 2026 ko
items.what: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) 2020-21 Series VII ke premature redemption ki date 19 October 2026 fix hui hai. Is date par aapka SGB aap chaahe to paisa lekar wapas kar sakte hain. Redemption price fix hua hai ₹14,614 per unit, gold ke last 3 din ke average par.
items.who: SGB 2020-21 Series VII bond holders jin ka issue date 20 October 2020 tha.
items.action: Agar aapke paas SGB 2020-21 Series VII hai, toh bank/DP se redemption form bhar sakte hain. Apne documents ready rakhein aur redemption process start karen.

items.headline: SEBI ne InvIT rules badle: depository receipts, voting naye
items.what: SEBI ne InvIT rules ko badla hai. Ab depository receipts allow honge. Sponsor exit par dissenting unitholders ki protection badhi hai, aur voting requirement mein bhi changes aaye hain.
items.who: Jo bhi investors, sponsors ya unit holders InvITs mein involved hain.
items.action: Agar aap InvIT sponsor ya investor hain, nayi depository receipts, voting rules aur sponsor exit ko samjhein. Legal ya compliance advisor se check karen.

items.headline: SEBI ne REIT rules aur voting, sponsor exit mein badlaav kiya
items.what: SEBI ne REIT regulations update ki hai. Ab depository receipts milenge, voting rules badle aur sponsor exit aur infra se related provisions revise hue hain.
items.who: REIT investors, sponsors, real estate fund managers, aur unitholders.
items.action: REIT mein invest ya kaam karne wale nayi rules aur voting changes detail mein padhein. Apne compliance ya legal team se ek baar confirm karen.

items.headline: SEBI AIF rules mein naye accredited investor criteria aaye
items.what: SEBI ne AIF regulations mein securities market exposure ke basis par accredited investor ke naye criteria add kiye hain aur dispute resolution rules ko revise kiya hai.
items.who: Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) managers, investors aur financial advisors.
items.action: AIF managers aur investors apni eligibility aur compliance criteria check karen. Naye accredited investor rules samjhein aur dispute resolution process dekhein.

items.headline: SEBI: Non-convertible debt securities ki mandatory listing
items.what: SEBI ne Regulation 62A revise kiya hai. Ab kuch listed entities ke subsequent non-convertible debt securities ki listing mandatory kar di gayi hai.
items.who: Wo listed companies jo non-convertible debt securities issue karti hain.
items.action: Agar aap listed company mein compliance dekhte hain, toh nayi listing requirement ko dekhein aur future issuances ka process accordingly update karen.

items.headline: Sovereign Gold Bond Series VII ka premature redemption 19 Oct ko
items.what: Sovereign Gold Bond 2020-21 Series VII ka premature redemption allowed hai 5 saal ke baad. Is batch ka redemption 19 October 2026 ko hoga, kyunki 20 October holiday hai. Redemption price ₹14,614 per unit hai, jo last 3 din ke average gold rate par depend karta hai.
items.who: Un logon par jinke paas SGB 2020-21 Series VII bond hai.
items.action: Agar aapke paas ye bond hai aur 5 saal ho gaye hain, toh 19 October 2026 ko bank/DP se redemption request daal sakte ho. Redemption price check kar lo aur required documents ready rakkho.

items.headline: Non-convertible debt securities ka naya listing rule
items.what: SEBI ne Regulation 62A amend kiya hai. Ab kuch listed companies ko jo naye non-convertible debt securities issue karte hain, unhe bhi list karna zaroori ho gaya hai.
items.who: Woh listed companies jo naye non-convertible debt securities issue karti hain.
items.action: Agar aap listed company mein compliance handle karte hain, toh non-convertible debt issue se pehle listing ki new requirement poori karna jaroori hai.

items.headline: REIT rules mein naye change: Depository receipts & sponsor exit
items.what: SEBI ne REIT Regulations ko amend kiya hai. Ab REITs depository receipts issue kar sakte hain. Unitholder voting aur sponsor ke exit rules bhi revise hue hain.
items.who: Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) aur unke investors par lagu ho raha hai.
items.action: REIT structure ya investment mein interest hai to naye rules padho, sponsor exit aur voting rights check karo. Compliance team ko update karo.

items.headline: SEBI ne AIF rules mein naya accredited investor criteria laya
items.what: AIF Regulations mein changes laye gaye hain. Ab accredited investor banne ke liye securities market exposure ka naya criteria lagega. Dispute resolution rules bhi update hue hain.
items.who: Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) aur naya capital raise karne wale funds/investors.
items.action: Agar aap AIF manage karte hain ya invest karne ki soch rahe hain, toh naya investor criteria aur dispute process samajh lo. Documentation update kar lo.

items.headline: SEBI ne SME IPO ke rules badalne ka proposal diya
items.what: SEBI ne October 2026 mein SME IPOs ke liye naye proposal laaye hain. Inmein market-cap eligibility, ₹3 crore operating profit, QIB allotment, lock-in, trading lots aur migration rules ka mention hai.
items.who: SMEs jo IPO lane ki soch rahe hain ya process mein hain. Unke advisors aur investors bhi affected hain.
items.action: Agar SME IPO la rahe ho ya planning kar rahe ho, apne merchant banker se naya eligibility aur allotment process samjho. Naye profitability aur market-cap requirements check karo.

items.headline: SEBI Research Analyst registration ka guide update
items.what: SEBI Research Analyst registration ke liye eligibility, NISM certificate, documents, fees aur RAASB deposit ki full guide aayi hai. Form A aur compliance process bhi include hai.
items.who: Research analyst banna chahte candidates ya firms, aur jo already registered hain.
items.action: Agar Research Analyst banna hai, to NISM certificate, Form A aur sab documents ready rakho. Registration fees aur compliance ki detail padh lo. Apne compliance officer ya consultant se process verify kar lo.

items.headline: RBI ne import payments aur IDPMS ke naye rules lagu kiye
items.what: RBI ne import ka paisa bhejne ki process update ki hai. Ab contract-based payment, ₹10 lakh ke IDPMS closure, advance payments, guarantees, GST, TDS aur accounting par naye rules hai. Ye rules 1 October 2026 se lagu ho gaye hain.
items.who: Import karne wale businesses, unke CA, CS aur accountants.
items.action: Agar aap import karte ho, to bank se IDPMS closure aur payment ka latest process samjho. GST, TDS aur advance ke naye rules CA se check kar lo. Saare compliance timely complete karo.

items.headline: RBI Liberalised Remittance Scheme 2026 guide nikali gayi
items.what: RBI ne LRS 2026 ka guide issue kiya hai. Ismein USD 250,000 annual limit, remittances, forex restrictions, TCS rates, Form A2, Schedule FA aur foreign asset reporting details hai.
items.who: Individuals ya businesses jo foreign remittance karte hain ya assets rakhte hain bahar.
items.action: Aapko apni remittance planning mei LRS ki limit, Form A2 aur TCS ka dhyan rakhna hai. Income tax return file karte waqt Schedule FA aur overseas asset reporting sahi karo.

items.headline: RBI ne NDDC INR contracts ke rules badle
items.what: Ab Authorised Dealer banks INR wale Non-Deliverable Derivative Contracts (NDDC) non-resident users ko sirf hedging ke liye offer kar sakte hain. Pehle koi purpose restriction nahi thi, ab sirf hedging allowed hai.
items.who: Authorised Dealer Category-I banks aur IFSC Banking Units jo NDDC offer karte hain, aur unke videshi clients.
items.action: Agar aap NDDC INR contracts deal karte hain, to ensure karo ki saare naye hedge-specific guidelines follow ho rahe hain. Non-resident clients ko ijjat se changes batao. Compliance aur documentation update karo.

items.headline: Sovereign Gold Bond 2019-20 Series V prematurity redemption info
items.what: Agar aapke paas SGB 2019-20 Series V hai, to aap 5 saal baad, yaani 15 October 2026 ko bond ki wo unit jaldi bech sakte hain. Is baar, ek unit ka redemption price ₹14,725/- fix hua hai, gold ke average IBJA rate ki hisaab se.
items.who: SGB 2019-20 Series V waale investors jinhe 15 October 2026 ko payment milega.
items.action: Apne demat account ya SGB ki details check karein. Redemption proceeds bank mein credit honge. Tax treatment samajhne ko apne CA se poochhein.

items.headline: Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) 2026 ka naya guide aaya
items.what: RBI ke LRS ke tahat, ek saal mein USD 250,000 tak remittance allowed hai, jaise ki foreign education, investment, travel, gift wagairah. Isme Form A2, TCS aur FEMA compliance lagegi. Overseas assets ko income tax return mein bhi dikhana hai.
items.who: Indian residents jo paisa bahar bhejna ya invest karna chaahte hain.
items.action: Remittance se pehle apne bank se Form A2 aur TCS rules confirm karein. Overseas investment ki reporting schedule FA mein sahi se karein.

items.headline: PNB ka 666 din wala FD - October 2026 Rates aur fayde
items.what: Punjab National Bank ne 666 din ki special FD scheme nikaali hai. Isme alag-alag interest rate seniors, super-seniors, aur dusre depositors ke liye hai. TDS aur DICGC cover ki bhi detail di gayi hai.
items.who: PNB ke naye ya existing FD kholne waale depositors, including seniors.
items.action: Fixed deposit kholne ke liye branch visit karein ya online apply karein. TDS aur insurance terms dhyaan se samjhein.

items.headline: RBI ne NDDCs ke rules badle for Non-Residents
items.what: Ab Authorised Dealer banks sirf hedging purpose ke liye Non-deliverable Derivative Contracts (NDDCs) INR basis par non-residents ko de sakenge. Pehle kisi bhi maqsad ke liye allowed tha, ab sirf risk se bachav ke liye.
items.who: All Authorised Dealer Category-I banks, IFSC units, aur Standalone Primary Dealers dealing with non-resident clients.
items.action: NDDC offer/accept karte waqt ensure karein ki client ka hedging document/proof submit ho. Non-resident clients ko naya rule samjhaa dein.

items.headline: UPI Merchant Discount Rate abhi defer ho gayi hai
items.what: NPCI ne decide kiya hai ki jo select UPI merchant transactions par Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) lagne wali thi, usko ab Diwali ke baad implement kiya jayega. Filhal business par is baat ka asar nahi padega.
items.who: Jo bhi merchant ya business UPI payments accept karte hain.
items.action: Diwali ke baad MDR ke rules check karein. Tab tak, koi naya charge nahi lagega. Apne payment service provider se detail samjhein.

items.headline: IFSCA ne Credit Info Companies par working group banaya
items.what: IFSCA ne ek Technical Working Group banayi hai jo Credit Information Companies ke data reporting, sudhar aur coordination ko mazboot karegi, khaaskar GIFT IFSC mein.
items.who: GIFT IFSC mein kaam kar rahi credit information companies aur data users.
items.action: Agar aapka kaam credit information companies se hai ya IFSC mein entity ho, naye reporting ya compliance rules ke updates par nazar rakho.

items.headline: FCNR(B) Deposit Rules 2026 mein badlav aur nayi safety points
items.what: RBI ne FCNR(B) deposit par rate-cap rules August 2026 se change kiye hain. Ismein tenures, currency options, FEMA, tax exemption, withdrawal, DICGC insurance aur NRI risk ko include kiya gaya hai.
items.who: Foreign currency accounts rakhne wale NRI, banks aur unke advisors.
items.action: Naye deposit kholte waqt bank se current FCNR(B) cap aur FEMA, tax rules confirm karo. Withdrawal aur currency risk dhang se samjho.

items.headline: UPI par select merchant MDR, Diwali ke baad lagu hoga
items.what: NPCI ne announce kiya hai ki kuch merchant UPI transactions par MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) abhi nahi lagega; yeh Diwali ke baad se lagu hoga.
items.who: UPI payment lene wale business aur merchants.
items.action: Abhi ke liye aapko extra MDR charges nahi lagenge. Lekin Diwali ke baad changes ke liye accounting system update kar lo.

items.headline: MSME ki late payment recovery par guide CAs ke liye
items.what: MSME ki delayed payment recovery, MSEFC claim ki process, interest lagne ke rule, Udyam registration aur Section 43B(h) par ek detailed guide aayi hai.
items.who: MSME owners, practising CAs aur advisors jinhe MSME recovery cases dekhne hain.
items.action: Clients ya khud MSME ho to Udyam registration kara lo. Delay hone par MSEFC mein claim filing aur interest calculation ki process samjho.

items.headline: RBI ne INR derivative contract rules mein badlav kiya
items.what: Ab Authorised Dealer banks INR ke non deliverable derivative contracts (NDDCs) non-resident ko sirf hedging ke liye de sakte hain, kisi aur purpose ke liye nahi.
items.who: Authorised Dealer banks, IFSC banking units aur non-resident users jo NDDC ka use karte hain.
items.action: AD banks ab sirf hedging wali needs ke liye hi aise contract offer karenge. Bank ki policy forms aur customer declaration update karo.

items.headline: NDDC deals ab sirf hedging ke liye non-residents ko
items.what: RBI ne decide kiya hai ki ab authorised dealers banks sirf hedging purpose ke liye hi non-deliverable derivative contracts (NDDC) INR mein non-resident users ko de sakte hain. Pehle koi bhi purpose allowed tha, ab sirf risk se bachav ke liye.
items.who: Authorised Dealer Category-I banks jo IFSC mein kaam karte hain aur Standalone Primary Dealers jinhe Authorised Dealer Category-III ka status hai.
items.action: Agar aap AD bank ya primary dealer hain to apni derivative ki policy turant update karo. Sirf hedging se related NDDC hi offer karo. Clients ko bhi inform karo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: Mutual Funds ki ad rules ab Common Code ke hisaab se
items.what: SEBI ne Mutual Funds ke advertisement ke rules badal diye hain. Pehle kuch alag rules the, ab Intermediaries Regulations ke Common Advertisement Code follow honge.
items.who: Saare Mutual Funds aur unke advertisement banane wale agencies.
items.action: Mutual Fund houses apne marketing content aur ads ko Common Advertisement Code ke hisaab se dobara review karein. New compliance rules padhein.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: SEBI ne Mutual Funds ke Regulations 2026 amend kiye
items.what: SEBI ne 2026 me Mutual Funds ke regulations dobara badle hain. Yeh 'Second Amendment' regulations hain, details circular me di gayi hain.
items.who: India ki sabhi Mutual Funds aur fund managers.
items.action: Sabhi AMCs aur compliance professionals ko yeh amendment jaldi se padh lena chahiye. Policy aur process ko naye rules ke hisaab se update karo.

items.authority: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.headline: IPO mein lock-in rules samjho: SEBI ICDR Regulation
items.what: SEBI ICDR Regulations ke hisaab se promoters aur pre-IPO shareholders ke liye lock-in period aur kuch capital expenditure conditions hoti hain. Main Board aur SME IPOs dono par lagu hai.
items.who: Promoters, pre-IPO shareholders aur jo Main Board ya SME IPO la rahe hain.
items.action: Agar IPO plan kar rahe ho ya shares lene wale ho to lock-in period aur SEBI ICDR ki terms padh lo. Company ka secretarial team process check karein.

items.headline: MSME 45-day payment rule: Delayed payment ka kya karein
items.what: Micro aur small enterprises apne delayed payments ko MSMED Act ke tehat recover kar sakte hain. 45 din ke andar payment nahi milta to compound interest ka haq banta hai. Recovery ke liye MSEFC approach kar sakte hain ya Section 43B(h) ka use ho sakta hai.
items.who: Sirf micro aur small suppliers ko, jinhe customer ne payment nahi diya hai.
items.action: Agar aap micro ya small enterprise ho aur payment delay ho gayi hai, to apne buyer ko follow up karo, interest claim note karo, aur zarurat pade to MSEFC mein complaint file karo. Account section ko bhi process samjhao.

items.headline: INR derivatives ke liye RBI Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve laaya
items.what: RBI ne foreign exchange derivative contracts (INR related) par Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR) ki requirement lagu ki hai. Ye reserve sirf un contracts par lagega jo USD 2 million se zyada ke hain aur jo current account transaction ke liye liye ja rahe hain.
items.who: INR derivative contracts lene wale businesses, jinka contract USD 2 million se zyada ka hai aur hedging ke liye hai.
items.action: Agar aapka INR derivative contract USD 2 million se upar ka hai to bank se check karo ki FERR ki requirement kaisi hai. Daily cash deposit aur reporting ka compliance dekh lo.

items.headline: SEBI ne Settlement Regulations 2026 jari kiye
items.what: SEBI ne 2026 ke naye Settlement Regulations notify kiye hain. Ab settlement fees, deadlines aur fast-track process naya hai. Ab application process aur disclosures bhi badal gaye hain.
items.who: Listed company, intermediaries, aur SEBI ke regulation ke under aane wale logon par ye rules lagu hain, jab wo settlement chahte hain.
items.action: Agar SEBI matter settle karne ki soch rahe ho to naye fees structure aur deadlines check karo. Fast-track procedure aur required documents list bana lo.

items.headline: SEBI ne Credit Risk-o-Meter naya disclosure tool laya
items.what: SEBI ne debt securities ke liye Credit Risk-o-Meter ka naya disclosure mechanism start kiya hai. Isse investors ko risk profile clearly samajh aayega.
items.who: Debt securities issue karne wali companies aur unmein paisa lagane wale investors ke liye.
items.action: Agar aap debt security issue karte ho to ab Credit Risk-o-Meter information disclose karni hogi. Investor ho to investment se pehle risk-o-meter check karo.

items.headline: SBI Amrit Vrishti 444 din wali FD par rules update hue
items.what: SBI Amrit Vrishti 444 din ki FD ki detail aayi hai. Isme interest rate, maturity, premature withdrawal aur TDS rules diye hain. DICGC cover bhi milega.
items.who: FD open karne wale naye aur existing SBI customers, including senior citizens.
items.action: Interest rates, withdrawal rules aur maturity tarikh padh ke hi FD kholna. Apne advisor se document aur tax implication samajh lo.

items.headline: RBI ne INR derivatives par 20% risk reserve mandatory kiya
items.what: RBI ne decide kiya hai ki INR foreign exchange derivative contract, jo USD 2 million se zyada ke hon aur hedging ke liye liye jaate hain, un par 20% Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR) rakhna hoga. Iska matlab hai daily cash deposit aur reporting karni padegi.
items.who: Jo bhi business ya dealer INR derivative contract kar rahe hain, jiska value USD 2 million se zyada hai aur current account hedging ke liye hai.
items.action: Agar aap aise INR derivatives karte hain to apne authorised dealer se poochiye ki FERR ki requirement puri ho rahi hai ya nahi. Daily cash deposit aur reporting ka dhyan rakhiye.

items.headline: SEBI ne Settlement Regulations 2026 notify kiye
items.what: SEBI ne naye Settlement Regulations 2026 notify kiye hain. Isme settlement amount ka calculation, application deadlines, fast-track procedures aur naye disclosure rules shamil hain.
items.who: Jo bhi listed companies, market participants ya investors SEBI ke jurisdiction mein hai aur un par proceeding chal rahi hai.
items.action: Agar aap par SEBI ka koi case ya notice hai, to naye Settlement Regulations 2026 ko padhein aur application deadlines pe dhyan dein. Advisor se sampark karein.

items.headline: Debt securities ke liye Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure introduce hua
items.what: SEBI ne Credit Risk-o-Meter introduce kiya hai, jo debt securities mein risk ko aur clearly disclose karega. Iss se investor ko bonds aur debentures ka risk level samajhna asaan hoga.
items.who: Jo bhi company debt securities issue karti hai ya investors jo debt instruments mein paisa lagate hain.
items.action: Iss naye disclosure ko dhyan se dekhein jab bhi koi debt security kharidein ya bechein. Prospectus ya offer document mein Credit Risk-o-Meter check karein.

items.headline: SEBI propose kar raha hai NCD listing relief Regulation 62A ke liye
items.what: SEBI ne propose kiya hai ki pehli baar NCD (Non-Convertible Debentures) issue karne wale issuers ko retrospective listing se kuch relief mile. Lekin aage jaake jo debt securities issue hongi, un par listing mandatory rahegi.
items.who: Jo entities pehli baar NCD issue kar rahe hain ya NCD mein invest karna chahte hain.
items.action: Naye proposal ke impact ko samjhein. Agar aap NCD issuer hain to legal advisor ya merchant banker se discussion karein ki aapko kya process follow karna hai.

items.headline: RBI ne Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve ka rule laya
items.what: RBI ne Authorized Dealers ko bola hai ki foreign currency derivative contracts par ek Foreign Exchange Risk Reserve (FERR) maintain karna hoga. Ye Reserve sirf un contracts par lagega jo INR aur foreign currency ke beech hai aur notional value 2 million USD se zyada hai. Sirf current account hedge karne walon par lagu.
items.who: Sabhi Authorized Dealers jinke clients foreign currency buy kar rahe hain INR ke against, jinke contracts 2 million USD se zyada ke hain.
items.action: Agar aap exporter, importer ya aise user ho jo INR mein foreign exchange derivative contract karte ho, to apne bank/AD se confirm karo ki FERR Reserve ki detail samajhi aur follow ki gayi hai.

items.headline: SEBI ne naya Settlement Framework launch kiya
items.what: SEBI ne 2026 ke Settlement Regulations notify kiye hain. Ab settlement ki calculation, application deadline, fast track process aur disclosure zyada transparent ho gaye hain.
items.who: Sabhi listed companies, intermediaries aur un individuals par jo SEBI proceeding settle karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap par SEBI matter hai ya settlement soch rahe hain, to naye rules check karo aur apne compliance adviser se discuss karo.

items.headline: SEBI ne REITs, InvITs ke liye Depository Receipts ka proposal diya
items.what: SEBI ne IFSC par listed REITs aur InvITs ke liye depository receipt introduce karne ka suggestion diya hai. Private InvITs ke liye safeguards rakhe jayenge aur NRI investors bhi include honge.
items.who: Jo groups REITs ya InvITs ko IFSC me list karna chahte hain, aur NRI investors.
items.action: Agar aap REIT, InvIT sponsor ya NRI ho, to proposal ki detail padh ke feedback de sakte ho ya apni investment strategy accordingly plan kar sakte ho.

items.headline: Debt securities par Credit Risk-o-Meter ka naya disclosure
items.what: SEBI ne debt securities ke liye Credit Risk-o-Meter ka additional disclosure introduce kiya hai. Is se investors ko debt product ki risk profile samajhne mein asani hogi.
items.who: Mutual funds, debt security issuers aur investors in products like bonds or debentures.
items.action: Agar aap debt securities dekh rahe hain ya deal karte hain, to ab Credit Risk-o-Meter check karo taaki risk assessment asaan ho.

items.headline: SEBI ne Settlement Regulations 2026 notify kiye
items.what: SEBI ne naye Settlement Regulations 2026 la diye hain. Isme settlement process, fees calculation aur deadlines update ki gayi hai. Fast-track procedure aur disclosure bhi include hai.
items.who: Securities market ke participants jin par SEBI ke administrative ya civil proceedings chal rahe hain.
items.action: Agar aap par SEBI ki enquiry ya case chal raha hai to naye settlement process ki guidelines achhi tarah padhein ya apne compliance advisor se poochein.

items.headline: SEBI ne NCD listing rule mein kuch relaxation propose kiya
items.what: SEBI ne Regulation 62A mein proposal diya hai ki first-time NCD issuers ko retrospective listing se relief mile. Lekin baad ke debt securities par mandatory listing continue rahegi.
items.who: Wo companies jo pehli baar secured NCD issue kar rahi hain.
items.action: Agar aap NCD issue karne ka plan bana rahe hain to latest SEBI proposals check karein. Apne compliance team ya advisor se consult karein.

items.headline: REITs aur InvITs ke liye IFSC mein depository receipts ka proposal
items.what: SEBI ne proposal diya hai ki IFSC mein listed REITs aur InvITs ke liye depository receipts shuru ki ja sakein. Safeguards bhi honge, khaaskar private InvITs aur NRI participation ke liye.
items.who: Jo log IFSC mein listed REITs ya InvITs mein invest karna chahte hain, khaaskar NRIs.
items.action: Agar aap IFSC REITs ya InvITs mein interest rakhte hain to SEBI ke naya proposal aur guidelines dekhein. Investment adviser se advice lein.

items.headline: Debt securities ke liye Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure laya gaya
items.what: SEBI ne debt securities me ab ek naya Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure introduce kiya hai. Isse investors ko risk clearly samajh aayega.
items.who: Debt securities investors aur issuers.
items.action: Agar aap debt securities issue ya invest kar rahe hain to Credit Risk-o-Meter ka format dekhein. Apne disclosures update karein.

items.headline: AIFI capital adequacy norms international standard ke mutabik hue
items.what: RBI ne All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) ke capital adequacy rules amend kiye hain. Legal opinion wala rule ab international standard ke saath align hoga.
items.who: All India Financial Institutions jo RBI ke capital adequacy norms follow karte hain.
items.action: AIFI ke compliance ya treasury team ko naye amendment directions dhyan se padhne chahiye aur process update karna chahiye.

items.headline: RBI ne AIFI capital rules mein badlav kiya
items.what: RBI ne All India Financial Institutions ke capital adequacy norms mein amendment kiya hai. Legal opinion lene wali requirement ko international standards ke hisaab se align kiya gaya hai.
items.who: All India Financial Institutions (AIFIs) jo clearing member financial institutions hain.
items.action: AIFI compliance team ko nayi amendment padhni chahiye aur legal opinion process mein changes implement karne chahiye.

items.headline: Debt securities ke liye Credit Risk-o-Meter mandatory
items.what: SEBI ne decide kiya hai ki ab debt securities ke offer documents aur advertisements mein Credit Risk-o-Meter dikhana compulsory hoga.
items.who: Jo bhi entity debt securities offer kar rahi hai ya unka advertisement bana rahi hai.
items.action: Issuance ya advertisement plan karte waqt Credit Risk-o-Meter disclosure banwana zaruri hai, compliance team se confirm kar lo.

items.headline: RBI ne repo rate 5.50% tak badhaya
items.what: RBI ne repo rate mein 0.25% ka hike kiya hai aur ab rate 5.50% ho gaya. Isse borrowing ka cost increase ho jayega.
items.who: Banks, NBFCs, corporates jinpar lending ya borrowing ka direct asar padta hai.
items.action: Cost of borrowing mein change check karo, naye loan plan karo ya EMI re-calculate karlo. Existing loans par bhi rate change samjho.

items.headline: LIC Bima Platinum Plan 770 ke benefits aur tax rules
items.what: LIC Bima Platinum Plan 770 ek insurance product hai, jisme guaranteed addition, income benefits aur GST rules ka detail diya gaya hai.
items.who: Jo log nayi insurance policy lene ka plan kar rahe hain ya Bima Platinum 770 ko consider kar rahe hain.
items.action: Aap plan ki eligibility, benefits aur tax impact samajhkar policy lene ka decision le sakte hain. Details ke liye apne LIC agent se pooch sakte hain.

items.headline: Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme 2026 ki guide aayi
items.what: FAST-DS 2026 ka pura guide aaya hai. Yahan eligibility, limit, payment process aur fees ki info di gayi hai. Isme aapko foreign assets declare karne ka mauka milega, certain rules ko follow karna hoga.
items.who: Un small taxpayers ke liye jinke paas foreign assets hain aur scheme ki limits mein fit baithte hain.
items.action: Agar aapke paas foreign assets hain, to Form 1 fill karein aur guide dekhein. Scheme ki limits aur timelines check karein.

items.headline: Vishal Nirmiti IPO details aur tax guide
items.what: Vishal Nirmiti IPO par ek detailed guide aayi hai. Iss guide mein issue size, price band, lot size, OFS, aur tax implications cover kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Un investors ke liye jo IPO mein invest karna chahte hain ya tax impact samajhna chahte hain.
items.action: IPO invest karne se pehle guide padh lein. Khud ki tax planning aur paperwork ready karein.

items.headline: LIC Jeevan Utsav plan mein loan ki facility explained
items.what: LIC Jeevan Utsav plan ki guarantee income, loan option, premium term, surrender aur tax rules par explanation di gayi hai.
items.who: Un logon ke liye jo LIC Jeevan Utsav plan mein invest kar rahe hain ya loan lena chahte hain.
items.action: Agar aap LIC Jeevan Utsav le rahe hain, to loan aur surrender ki terms check karein. Income-tax Act 2025 aur GST rules bhi samjhein.

items.headline: Axis Bank Fixed Deposit ka October 2026 guide
items.what: Axis Bank FD par latest rates, senior citizen benefit, premature withdrawal aur TDS rules ka guide aaya hai. DICGC cover aur Form 121 details bhi di gayi hain.
items.who: Axis Bank ke FD holders aur nayi FD open karne walon ke liye.
items.action: Nai FD kholte waqt latest rates aur tenure dekhein. TDS aur tax rules check karein, Form 121 use karna ho to paperwork ready karein.

items.headline: Note Sorting Machines par RBI ka naya Master Direction
items.what: RBI ne Note Sorting Machines ke liye Master Direction jari kiya hai. Ab sabhi banks ko ek hi jagah updated guidelines mil jayengi. Purane circular ab withdraw ho gaye hain.
items.who: Ye sabhi banks par lagu hai jo Note Sorting Machines use karte hain.
items.action: Aapke bank branch mein Note Sorting Machine ka use hai to staff ko ab naye Master Direction padhein aur follow karein. Purane circulars ko ab mat dekhein.

items.headline: ICICI Bank FD: Rate aur TDS ki latest guide
items.what: ICICI Bank ki FD par abhi kaunse interest rates mil rahe hain, tenure kya hai, premature withdrawal par kya rules hain, TDS kaise katega - is guide mein diya gaya hai. DICGC cover ki bhi detail milti hai.
items.who: Jo log ICICI Bank mein FD rakhna chahte hain ya rakh rahe hain, unke liye hai.
items.action: Nayi FD karwane se pehle rate, tenure, premature withdrawal aur TDS rules is guide se check karein. Senior citizens alag benefit bhi dekh sakte hain.

items.headline: Axis Bank FD: October 2026 ke rate aur withdrawal rules
items.what: Axis Bank ki FD par October 2026 ke interest rates, senior citizen ke liye alag rate, tenure, premature withdrawal aur TDS ke rules ki detail di gayi hai. DICGC cover ka bhi zikr hai.
items.who: Jo Axis Bank mein FD lena ya renew karna chahte hain, aur senior citizens.
items.action: FD karne ya renew karne se pehle latest rate aur withdrawal ke rule is guide se samjhein. Tax implication bhi check karein.

items.headline: LIC Jeevan Utsav: Guaranteed Income aur Loan ki suvidha
items.what: LIC Jeevan Utsav plan mein guaranteed income, premium ka term, death benefit, surrender ka option aur loan ki suvidha bhi milti hai. Tax aur GST rules bhi explain kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Personal finance planning karne wale individuals, specially jo insurance aur periodic income dekh rahe hain.
items.action: LIC Jeevan Utsav policy lene se pehle premium, loan option aur tax rules samjhein. Apne agent se sari terms confirm karein.

items.headline: Foreign Assets Disclosure Scheme 2026 ka guide aaya
items.what: Foreign Assets of Small Taxpayers Disclosure Scheme 2026 (FAST-DS 2026) ka detail guide aaya hai. Eligibility, 1 crore/5 crore ki limit, 60% payment, 1 lakh fee, Form 1 aur valuation ki detail milti hai. Timeline aur immunity rules bhi explain hain.
items.who: Small taxpayers jinke paas foreign assets hain, aur scheme ki defined limit mein aate hain.
items.action: Agar aap foreign assets disclose karna chahte hain, to eligibility, payment rules aur document Form 1 ki details scheme guide se padhein. Time par application karein.

items.headline: Vishal Nirmiti IPO: Main points aur tax implication
items.what: Vishal Nirmiti IPO ke issue details, price band, lot size, fresh issue/OFS aur risk factors is guide mein cover hain. IPO mein invest karne walon ke liye tax implication bhi samjhaye gaye hain.
items.who: IPO mein invest ya apply karne wale logon ke liye.
items.action: IPO mein apply karne se pehle issue ki main terms, risk factors aur tax impact ko guide se samjhein. Apni risk profile check karna na bhoolein.

items.headline: RBI Expected Credit Loss Framework: Banks ke liye naye rules
items.what: RBI Expected Credit Loss (ECL) framework 1 April 2027 se lagega. Ismein banks ko 3-stage provisioning karni padegi, yaani loan loss ko pehle se estimate karna aur capital relief ka bhi rule hai.
items.who: Sabhi scheduled banks jo loan aur credit products issue karte hain.
items.action: Bank branch managers aur auditors ECL framework ki guidelines detail mein samjhein. IT systems aur policy update ki planning abhi se shuru karein.

items.headline: Note sorting machines ke naye rules RBI ne jaari kiye
items.what: RBI ne note sorting machines par ek Master Direction jaari kiya hai. Saare purane guidelines, circulars ab consolidate ho gaye hain. Ab sirf BIS-certified note sorting machines hi use hongi.
items.who: Yeh sabhi banks par lagu hai jo cash handle karte hain.
items.action: Aapke bank branch ya cash operations mein note sorting machine hai to check karo ki woh BIS-certified hai ya nahi. Master Direction ka ek copy staff ko circulate karo.

items.headline: RBI ne 268 purane circulars withdraw kiye currency par
items.what: RBI ne currency management se jude 268 purane circulars aur guidelines hata diye hain. Yeh sab consolidate karke Master Directions mein daale gaye hain ya purane ho gaye hain.
items.who: Banks aur woh sab organizations jo cash ya currency se jude operations chalate hain.
items.action: Ab reference ke liye sirf RBI ke latest Master Directions dekho; purane circulars par kaam mat karo.

items.headline: Digital Rupee par RBI ke naye FAQs aage
items.what: RBI ne digital rupee (e₹) par naya FAQs set jaari kiya hai. Isme e₹ wallet, UPI interoperability aur wholesale CBDC ke baare mein bataya gaya hai.
items.who: Fintechs, banks, aur koi bhi digital currency interest rakhne wale log aur businesses.
items.action: Agar aap digital rupee ko use ya integrate karna soch rahe ho to RBI ke naye FAQs check karo. Apne clients ko bhi update karo.

items.headline: SC/ST ke liye credit facilities par RBI ne rule saaf kiye
items.what: RBI ne SC/ST beneficiaries ko bank credit dene ke liye guidelines consolidate kiye hain. Main cheezein planning, lending aur reporting par focus karti hain.
items.who: Banks aur SC/ST borrowers jo priority sector mein loan lete hain.
items.action: Banks ko nayi consolidated guidelines ki copy apne branch managers ko bhejni chahiye. SC/ST clients se jude proposals issi ke hisaab se process karo.

items.headline: Local area aur small finance banks mein share kharidna aasan hua
items.what: RBI ne mutual funds, insurers aur pension funds ke liye major shareholding kharidne par one-time approval ki suvidha di hai. Ab baar-baar approval lene ki jaroorat nahi hogi agar aap ek bar clear ho gaye.
items.who: Mutual funds, insurance companies aur pension funds jo in banks mein investment ki planning kar rahe hain.
items.action: Agar aap mutual fund, insurance ya pension fund ho to apni shareholding strategy review karo. Relevant compliance documents ready rakho one-time approval ke liye.

items.headline: Note Sorting Machines ke liye naye RBI rules aaye
items.what: RBI ne Note Sorting Machines par Master Direction jari ki hai. Isme authentication, fitness sorting, calibration aur BIS-certified machines ka mention hai. Pehle ke rules ab withdraw ho gaye hain.
items.who: Saare banks jo note sorting machines use karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap bank branch sambhalte hain, to ab note sorting machine BIS-certified honi chahiye. Naye Master Direction ko padhkar implementation karein.

items.headline: Master Direction: Note Sorting Machines par consolidated guideline
items.what: RBI ne Note Sorting Machines par saari purani guidelines consolidate karke Master Direction jari ki hai. Pehle jari kiye circulars ab valid nahi hain.
items.who: Har bank ka MD, CEO, aur Chairman jin bankon mein cash note sorting machines hain.
items.action: Banks apne practices ab naye Master Direction ke hisaab se update karein. Pehle ki guidelines ab applicable nahi hain.

items.headline: Currency Management ki 268 purani guidelines withdraw hui
items.what: RBI ne currency management par 268 purani circulars aur guidelines hatakar unko Master Directions mein consolidate ya obsolete kar diya hai.
items.who: Banks ya institutions jo currency management ke related RBI ki guidelines follow karte hain.
items.action: Ab currency management ke liye sirf naye Master Directions hi follow karein. Purane circulars ki checklist revise karein.

items.headline: SC/ST beneficiaries ke liye bank loan par RBI master guideline
items.what: RBI ne SC/ST beneficiaries ke liye bank credit facilities par sari guidelines consolidate kar di hain. Isme planning, lending, aur monitoring covered hai.
items.who: Wo banks jo SC/ST customers ko loan dete hain, aur SC/ST borrowers.
items.action: Banks naye guidelines padhein aur ab loan policies accordingly update karein. SC/ST applicants lending criteria check karein.

items.headline: Digital Rupee FAQs update hue, wallet aur UPI par focus
items.what: RBI ne Digital Rupee (e₹) ke FAQs update kiye hain. Isme wallet, UPI se linking, aur CBDC ke use cases samjhaye hain.
items.who: Wo sab jo Digital Rupee ya RBI ke e₹ system mein interested hain, banks aur fintechs.
items.action: Digital Rupee se judi updated FAQs dekhein. UPI interoperability aur wallet ke points par focus karein agar aapka business ya client usme involved hai.

items.headline: RBI ne SC/ST ke liye loan guidelines update kiye
items.what: RBI ne banks ko SC/ST beneficiaries ko diya jaane wala loan ka pura guideline ek jagah consolidate kiya hai. Isme planning, lending, monitoring aur reporting sab cover hain.
items.who: Sabhi banks aur SC/ST category ke borrowers par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap SC/ST loan lene ki soch rahe hain ya bank se is loan ka process samajhna hai to naye guidelines check karein. Bank branch se guideline ka update maang sakte hain.

items.headline: Local Area Banks ke shares lene ka process badla
items.what: Agar aap Local Area Bank me major shareholding lena chahte hain to pehle RBI se approval lena hoga. Agar aapka shareholding dobara 5% se kam ho jaata hai, aur fir dobara major shareholding leni hai to fir se RBI approval chahiye.
items.who: Jo bhi vyakti ya entity Local Area Bank me major shareholding lene ki soch raha hai.
items.action: Share purchase plan karte waqt RBI se approval ka process samjhein. Legal ya compliance advisor se consult zarur karein.

items.headline: Small Savings Scheme ke interest rate change nahi hue
items.what: Small Savings Scheme jaise Sukanya, NSC, PPF ke interest rate October se December 2026 tak same hi rahenge. Koi rate mein badlav nahi hua hai.
items.who: Small Savings Schemes me paisa laga rakhe depositors aur naye investors ke liye.
items.action: Agar plan tha ki rate badlav ka intezar karenge, to abhi waise hi investment decision lein. Purane rate pe hi deposit renew ya naya khol sakte hain.

items.headline: Public InvIT listing ke liye compliance review jaldi karein
items.what: Agar InvIT ko public-list karna hai to pehle se structure, contracts, compliance aur governance ka review karna zaruri hai. SEBI ki requirements poori honi chahiye.
items.who: InvITs jo public listing plan kar rahe hain unke sponsors aur managers.
items.action: Legal, compliance aur auditors ke sath milkar apna poora documentation aur policy jaldi ready karein. Listing process shuru karne se pehle sab systems test karein.

items.headline: PLI scheme se pharma aur medical device manufacturing ko boost
items.what: PLI (Production Linked Incentive) scheme ki wajah se desh mein pharma, bulk drugs, aur medical devices ki manufacturing badh rahi hai. Naye investment aur jobs create ho rahe hain.
items.who: Pharma aur medical device companies, investors, aur unke suppliers ke liye.
items.action: Agar aap manufacturing sector me hain to PLI scheme ke benefits samjhein. Naye proposals ya expansion plan PLI terms ko dekhkar taiyaar karein.

items.headline: Small Savings Scheme Interest Rates October-December 2026 unchanged
items.what: Small Savings Scheme ki interest rates abhi bhi waise ki waise rahengi October se December 2026 tak. Koi badlav nahi hua hai.
items.who: Small Savings Scheme account holders aur naye invest karne wale.
items.action: Agar aapka paisa Small Savings me laga hai ya naya invest karna hai to abhi ki rates check kar sakte hain. Koi rate update ki zaroorat nahi hai.

items.headline: UAPA Section 51A par RBI ne ek entry update ki hai
items.what: RBI ne Section 51A of UAPA ke tahat UNSC sanctions list me ek entry update ki hai. Ye update AML-KYC compliance ke liye zaroori hai.
items.who: Sabhi banks, NBFCs, co-operative banks, financial institutions.
items.action: Compliance officer ya branch manager se check karein ki latest UNSC sanctions list implement ho gayi hai ya nahi. Apni AML/KYC policies update kar len.

items.headline: PLI Scheme se pharma aur medical device manufacturing me boost
items.what: PLI (Production Linked Incentive) scheme ki wajah se India me pharmaceuticals, bulk drugs aur medical devices ki manufacturing badh gai hai. Ye investment aur technology adoption ke liye help karta hai.
items.who: Pharmaceuticals, bulk drug, aur medical device manufacturers.
items.action: Agar aap pharma ya device sector me hain, to PLI scheme ke provisions check karein. Eligibility aur benefits ki latest list dekhein.

items.headline: UPI P2M transactions par MDR framework 15 Oct 2026 se lagu
items.what: 15 October 2026 se select UPI Person-to-Merchant transactions pe nayi MDR policy lagu ho rahi hai. Rates, threshold aur kuch exemptions di gayi hain.
items.who: UPI payments lene wale merchants aur payment service providers.
items.action: Aap merchant hai to apne payment partner se nayi MDR rates aur exemptions ki detail mangwaen. Khud ki billing/check-out system update karen.

items.headline: Public InvIT listing ke liye structure aur compliance pe focus
items.what: Agar InvIT ko public list karna hai to structure, contracts, governance, compliance aur historic records ka review zaruri hai. Early review hi best practice hai.
items.who: InvIT sponsors, managers aur compliance teams.
items.action: Listing ki planning kar raha InvIT jaldi hi apne structure, contracts, aur compliance records ki detailed review kare. Legal aur financial advisor ki madad le sakte hain.

items.headline: PLI se Bulk Drugs manufacturing aur supply chain mazboot
items.what: PLI Scheme ne bulk drugs, KSMs aur APIs ki domestic manufacturing aur supply chain resilience ko strong kiya hai. Import par dependence ghati hai.
items.who: Bulk drugs, KSM aur API manufacturers in India.
items.action: Agar aap is sector me kaam karte hain to PLI scheme ke rules, incentives aur compliance ki details regularly update karte rahen.

items.headline: RBI: ₹4,850 cr line of credit for Maldives
items.what: RBI ne Exim Bank ke through ₹4,850 crore ka Government of India-supported Line of Credit announce kiya hai. Ye fund Maldives ke developmental projects ke liye use hoga.
items.who: Financial institutions ya exporters jo Maldives ke development projects mein salvage ya supply karte hain.
items.action: Agar aapka business Maldives projects se juda hai, to Exim Bank ke guidelines aur eligibility check karein. Funding ke liye documentation Exim Bank se clear karein.

items.headline: IFSCA ne venture capital schemes mein alag-alag returns allow kiye
items.what: IFSCA ne Venture Capital aur Restricted Schemes mein differential distribution allow kar diya hai. Ab investors ko senior, junior aur subordinate units ke hisaab se alag alag returns mil sakte hain.
items.who: Venture Capital Funds aur unmein invest karne wale investors.
items.action: Scheme ki unit type (senior/junior/subordinate) samjhe aur risk-return ka comparison karein. Jo naye scheme design kar rahe hain, wo IFSCA ki guidelines padh lein.

items.headline: SEBI ne demat/mutual fund nomination simple kiya
items.what: SEBI ne nomination framework simplify kiya hai. Ab demat accounts aur mutual fund folios mein default nomination, opt-out ka option aur easy documentation hoga.
items.who: Sabhi investors jin ke paas demat account ya mutual fund folio hai ya kholne ka plan hai.
items.action: Nomination ki latest facility online check karein. Agar change ya update karni ho to ab process kaafi simple ho gaya hai, turant complete karein.

items.headline: Domestic PNG incentive: Extra APM gas allocation
items.what: Domestic PNG Connection Incentive Scheme ke tahat CGD entities ko har nayi billed household connection par 200 SCM extra APM gas milegi. Isse household gas coverage tez badhega.
items.who: City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities jo PNG household connections lagaati hain.
items.action: CGD entities ko har eligible nayi billed connection ki proper documentation rakhni hai jisse incentive claim easily ho sake.

items.headline: LLP Form 8: Financial statement ab optional
items.what: LLP Form 8 file karte waqt ab financial statements attach karna mandatory nahi hai. Web form mein accounts aur solvency ki details mange jaati hain; financials optional hai.
items.who: Sare Limited Liability Partnerships (LLP) jo Form 8 file karte hain.
items.action: Form 8 bharte waqt financial statement attach karna chahein to karein, nahi to accounts ki sari jaankari form mein bhar de.

items.headline: SEBI ne nomination process simple banaya demat & mutual fund ke liye
items.what: SEBI ne nomination ka process simple kar diya hai demat accounts aur mutual fund folios ke liye. Ab default nomination, opt-out choice aur document bhi simple ho gaya hai.
items.who: Sabhi demat account holders aur mutual fund investors par lagu hoga.
items.action: Aap apne demat account ya mutual fund folio nomination status check karein. Agar nomination nahi diya hai, to nayi process ke hisaab se jaldi se poora karein ya opt-out ka option chun sakte hain.

items.headline: LLP Form 8 mein financial statements optional hai abhi
items.what: Abhi ke web form LLP Form 8 mein accounts aur solvency ki detail mangi jati hai. Financial statements lagana mandatory nahi, optional hai.
items.who: Sabhi LLPs jo Form 8 bhar rahe hain.
items.action: Form 8 bharte waqt, aap financial statements chahe to laga sakte hain, par majboori nahi hai. Apne ROC consultant se confirm kar lein ki latest rule follow ho raha hai ya nahi.

items.headline: Domestic PNG scheme mein CGD ko extra APM gas allocation milega
items.what: Domestic PNG incentive scheme ke tahat, CGD entities ko har eligible nayi billed connection par 200 SCM extra APM gas milega. Isse ghar-ghar gas connection tezi se badhega.
items.who: Sabhi City Gas Distribution (CGD) companies jo PNG connections install kar rahe hain.
items.action: CGD companies ko eligible billed connections ki list ready rakhni chahiye. Scheme ka benefit paane ke liye sahi documentation apne end se submit karein.

items.headline: RBI ne Exim Bank ko Maldives projects ke liye line of credit di
items.what: RBI ne Exim Bank ko ₹4,850 crore ki GOI-supported line of credit di hai Maldives ke developmental projects ke liye.
items.who: Exim Bank, aur Maldives mein project lene wale Indian exporters ya suppliers.
items.action: Jo log Maldives mein project hissa lena chahte hain, wo Exim Bank ki guidelines check karein. Funding ke liye eligibility/procedure samjhein.

items.headline: RBI ne commercial banks ke liye market risk capital directions diye
items.what: RBI ne commercial banks ke liye nayi directions issue ki hain market risk capital requirements par. Ye trading book, interest rate, equity, forex, options sab pe lagu hoga.
items.who: Sare commercial banks jo trading activities karte hain.
items.action: Jo bhi commercial bank se jude ho, nai directions detail mein padhein. Apne risk team ya auditor se discuss karein ki aap ready hain ya nahi.

items.headline: Nippon Yield Maximiser Scheme par SEBI ka settlement order
items.what: Nippon Yield Maximiser AIF Scheme I ke maamle mein SEBI ka settlement order aaya hai.
items.who: Is scheme mein invest karne wale investors aur unke advisors.
items.action: Investors apne advisor se scheme status ke baare mein baat karein. Settlement order ka effect samjhein prior decision ya withdrawal se pehle.

items.headline: Exim Bank ne Maldives ke liye LOC approve ki
items.what: Exim Bank ne Maldives government ko ₹ 4,850 crore ka Line of Credit diya hai. Iska use waha ke development projects ke liye hoga. Export of eligible Indian goods and services bhi iss LOC ke under hoga.
items.who: Maldives government, aur India ke exporters jo eligible goods/services bechte hain.
items.action: Agar aap Indian exporter hain aur aapke goods eligible hain, to Exim Bank ya apne AD Bank se guidance lein. Export plan karne se pehle eligibility check karein.

items.headline: WDRA ne Aadhaar authentication voluntary kiya
items.what: Ab depositors aur warehousemen voluntary Aadhaar authentication kara sakte hain. Dusra ID option bhi hai, Aadhaar compulsory nahi hai.
items.who: Sabhi depositors, warehousemen ya stakeholders jinka WDRA se sambandh hai.
items.action: Warehouse ya commodity deposit karte waqt Aadhaar ya alternate ID option ka use kar sakte hain. Latest process WDRA portal par check karein.

items.authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
items.headline: Domestic PNG Scheme mein extra gas allocation milega
items.what: Domestic PNG (Piped Natural Gas) Connection Incentive Scheme ke under CGD companies ko har new billed household connection par 200 SCM extra APM gas milegi. Iska goal hai household PNG coverage badhana.
items.who: City Gas Distribution (CGD) companies jo domestic PNG connections lagate hain.
items.action: CGD companies apni billing aur reporting process mein scheme ke hisab se claim file karein. Har eligible billed connection par additional gas allocation ka benefit uthayein.

items.headline: RBI ne market risk ki capital directions jari ki
items.what: RBI ne commercial banks ke liye market risk capital ki directions notify ki hain. Trading book, interest rate, equity, forex aur options par focus hai.
items.who: Saare commercial banks jinke trading books yaa financial instruments mein exposure hai.
items.action: Bank apni risk management aur capital requirement policies ko in directions ke hisab se update karein. April 2027 tak tayyari puri karein.

items.headline: IFSCA ne naye jurisdiction IFSC distributors mein jode
items.what: IFSCA ne Master Circular amend kiya hai. Ab UAE, Singapore, Australia, aur EU bhi specified jurisdictions mein hai IFSC distribution activities ke liye.
items.who: IFSC registered distributors jo cross-border distribution ka business karte hain.
items.action: Distributors apna compliance process new jurisdiction list ke hisab se update karein. Nayi market entry plan ke liye Master Circular dekhein.

items.headline: IFSC Distributors ab UAE, Singapore, Australia, EU mein bhi allowed
items.what: IFSCA ne apne Master Circular ko amend kiya hai. Ab IFSC Distributors ko UAE, Singapore, Australia aur European Union mein distribution activity ki ijazat milegi.
items.who: Jo bhi IFSC mein registered distributors hain, aur ye countries/jurisdictions target karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap IFSC distributor ho to apna list update karo. Ye naye jurisdiction mil gaye hain, compliance check karo.

items.headline: FPIs ke liye certified KYC copy facility RBI ne badhai
items.what: RBI ne sabhi co-operative banks (rural, urban aur regional rural banks), Local Area Banks aur Small Finance Banks ko bola hai ki woh FPIs se KYC documents certified copy ke roop mein accept kar sakte hain. Certified copy yaani FPI apne documents ko kuch specified foreign authority se attest karwa sakte hain.
items.who: Ye rule Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) par lagu hai jo India mein co-operative, local area ya small finance banks ke through invest karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap FPI client handle karte ho, toh KYC document certification process check karo. Client ko certified copy ka process samjha do, aur kis authority se certification chahiye, ye clarify karo.

items.headline: PIT compliance par directors aur KMPs ko kya jaanna hai
items.what: SEBI ne PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) compliance ko lekar listed companies ke directors aur KMPs ke liye guide banayi hai. Isme UPSI, trading window, disclosure aur SDD jaisi cheezein cover ki gayi hain.
items.who: Listed company ke directors, KMPs aur compliance team.
items.action: Apne company ka SEBI PIT compliance policy dobara check karo. Recent amendments ya guide points implement kiye hain ya nahi, verify karo.
